intendedUse: Normalize a current Lithuanian five-digit postcode, retrieve a rights-cleared real postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon through the AGID API, fit the map and render a translucent area with a clear outline and complete provenance.
recordGrain: one current Lietuvos paštas postcode assignment and its truthful postcode surface, with address, delivery-area, endpoint, administrative, building and land records kept as separate authorities

m2Definition.definition: A current complete rights-cleared Lietuvos paštas postcode assignment denominator and its real postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon surfaces are pinned by response edition or retrieval basis, validity, type exceptions, terms, byte length and SHA-256, published as an approved immutable artifact, and loaded through the real LT API/app so a normalized five-digit search fits and renders a translucent area with a clear outline, selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual classification, source, reference date and confidence. Authenticated schema fields, Registrų centras address points, delivery areas, post offices, routes, PO boxes, organizations, administrative boundaries, buildings, buffers, Voronoi cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2 by themselves.

officialObservations.finding: The official interactive page searches address to postcode and postcode to addresses and displays code, post office, address and municipality. It publishes no bulk edition, coverage denominator, terms receipt or Polygon/MultiPolygon response. No address query was submitted.

The current API documents GET /api/v2/address/lt/postcodes and postcode-address lookup. PostCode has optional geoArea and geoCenterLocation; GeoArea is a sequence of latitude/longitude points. PostCodeType distinguishes Post, PostBox, Address and BigCustomer. The documentation says all communication must be authenticated, provider configuration is required, and production credentials follow successful test integration. It does not establish that geoArea is present and Polygon-valid for every current address postcode or grant public serving and redistribution rights.
The official business page requires a Lietuvos paštas contract before API integration is enabled. No contract, account, configuration, credentials or terms acceptance was requested or obtained.
A non-browser anonymous GET returned 401 Unauthorized with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer and an empty body. Transient cookies in the uncommitted capture were not retained in Git.

The official open-data portal declares public CC BY 4.0 annual nationwide Address Register points. Model AdresoTaskas includes pasto_koda plus WGS84 and LKS-94 coordinates. This is official civic-address point geometry, not postal-operator postcode-area authority.

The current public storage representation displays No data. The portal also lists an older 2021 JSON distribution, but no 373 MB raw address dump was downloaded and an old distribution cannot prove a current complete operator assignment or area.

The official portal still lists Lietuvos pašto kodų geografinės ribos as an evaluated/submitted open-data need rather than a published postcode-boundary dataset. This corroborates that no public official boundary release was found.

dataQuality.risk: The operator schema has a possible geoArea but its real coverage, postcode semantics, topology and public processing/serving/redistribution rights cannot be inspected without a configured contract account. Public registry data supplies points, not a postal boundary release.

browserReview.reason: No contract-authorized rights-cleared real LT postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact exists to exercise. Shared deterministic tests do not promote synthetic geometry.

blockerSummary: Lietuvos paštas documents an optional postcode geoArea, but all API communication is authenticated, provider configuration and a contract are required, and no public processing, serving or redistribution permission or complete current response denominator was obtained. Registrų centras publishes CC BY 4.0 postcode-bearing address points, while the official portal still treats postcode boundaries as an unmet open-data request. No rights-cleared real LT postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon or immutable artifact can be served or rendered.
unblockConditions: With explicit approval where a contract or authentication is required, obtain the current complete Lietuvos paštas postcode denominator and representative/full geoArea responses together with edition or retrieval basis, effective date, code-type coverage, terms, byte length and SHA-256.

Establish in writing that AGID may process, derive when necessary, publish through its API and redistribute the postcode areas, and determine whether geoArea denotes a postcode surface rather than a delivery-area, post-office or route surface.

Validate every eligible Polygon/MultiPolygon for ring closure, coordinate range, topology, LT partition, completeness and Post/PostBox/Address/BigCustomer exceptions; do not fill gaps with address-point buffers, Voronoi cells, administration or buildings.

Publish an approved immutable artifact with no raw addresses, persons, customers, buildings, cadastre or land-right data and pass real LT normalization, loader, API, fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
